words.gloss_range: deity or object of worship, here locally bound as the final construct title in the refuge sequence
words.root_gloss_range: worship, deifying, bewildered turning, shelter-seeking, and attachment images; the local noun selects the deity-title while allowing refuge-pressure to remain audible

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَٰهِ}} ({{tr:ilāhi}}) is not a standalone label; its genitive case keeps the word suspended from the refuge frame that began at 114:1, and its construct state makes {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) complete the title. The noun remains an analyzable construct rather than an article-marked standalone title or proper-name form, so the people define the deity relation grammatically. As the third title after {{ar:رَبِّ / مَلِكِ}} ({{tr:rabbi / maliki}}) (114:1-2), it moves the relation from care and rule into worshipful dependence. The root-family pressure of bewildered turning, shelter-seeking, and settled attachment is useful here when narrowed by the local noun: the phrase still names the deity of the people, but it also presents that title as the endpoint toward which vulnerable humans turn before the whispering threat is named (114:4-5). In recitation, the long vowel of {{ar:إِلَٰهِ}} ({{tr:ilāhi}}) flows into {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}), so the syntactic bond is heard as well as parsed; the two-word phrase also concentrates the divine-human pairing before 114:5 shifts attention to the human interior under threat.

topics.headline: carried genitive apposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the short ayah remains grammatically attached to the refuge request from 114:1 rather than forming an independent sentence.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:إِلَٰهِ}} ({{tr:ilāhi}}) as genitive and appositional to the earlier refuge object, while the attachment note warns that the single ayah can obscure the carried frame from 114:1.

topics.headline: construct-defined deity title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the deity-title defined through its human genitive complement, not by an explicit article or an isolated proper-name form.
topics.reason: The local grammar identifies {{ar:إِلَٰهِ}} ({{tr:ilāhi}}) as the first term of an idafa completed by definite {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}); no V4 row contradicts this construct reading.

topics.headline: final title escalation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the sequence culminate in worshipful dependence after care and kingship have already been named in 114:1-2.
topics.reason: The rows' tricolon claim is supported by the carried appositional series and by the repeated human genitive across the opening three ayahs.

topics.headline: bewildered refuge pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the deity-title as the endpoint of vulnerable turning, while still reading the local phrase as a title of worship.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows preserve worship, bewilderment, shelter, attachment, and dependency as root-family pressures, but local grammar selects a concrete noun in construct with {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}), so those images color the title rather than replacing it.

topics.headline: common noun form retained
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah keeps an analyzable deity noun in construct instead of shifting to the dominant proper-name form.
topics.reason: The occurrence and formula rows are useful as background, but the local payoff is limited to the retained common-noun construct shape in 114:3.

topics.headline: deity people root pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the two-word ayah as a concentrated divine-human relation that will soon be contrasted with the human interior threatened in 114:5.
topics.reason: The idafa makes the deity-human pairing local, and the inter-ayah row gives the concrete contrast with the human breasts in 114:5.

topics.headline: audible phrase bond
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitation joins the construct head to its human complement instead of letting the two words sound detached.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows match the syntactically forced idafa: the long title vowel and liaison into {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) make the phrase cohere in sound.

words.gloss_range: the people, human beings, the human collective; here the definite genitive complement to the deity-title
words.root_gloss_range: human sociality, familiarity, perceptibility, and collective peoplehood; forgetfulness remains a disputed etymological pressure rather than the selected local derivation

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) completes the construct as the governed human term, so the ayah does not merely place a deity-title beside a people-word; it makes the people the relation that specifies the title. The full noun is repeated instead of being compressed into a suffix, so humanity is fully re-sounded under each opening title rather than recovered only from memory. Because the same definite noun closes the first three ayahs and returns in 114:5 and 114:6, the human collective remains the surah's repeated landing point while its role changes: protected by the divine titles, entered by whispering, and finally included among possible whispering sources. The root-family pressure of sociability, familiar companionship, and visibility is best kept as coloring, not replacement: this is the collective people, heard as a socially exposed public rather than an isolated individual or abstract species. Its repeated ending and assimilated onset also make the human word the acoustic close of the refuge formula.

topics.headline: genitive complement relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are the governed relation-term completing the deity-title, not a separate subject or loose noun.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both mark {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) as the genitive second term governed by {{ar:إِلَٰهِ}} ({{tr:ilāhi}}).

topics.headline: repeated definite human refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears one definite human collective recur across the surah instead of seeing each divine title attach to a different constituency.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence labels this as a strongly licensed verbatim refrain anchored at 114:1, and the rows track the repeated definite form through 114:1, 114:2, 114:3, 114:5, and 114:6.

topics.headline: full noun not pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that humanity is fully re-sounded after each title rather than compressed into a recoverable suffix.
topics.reason: The local surface repeats the definite noun as an ayah-ending term, matching the CRITICAL contrast with possible pronominal compression.

topics.headline: collective social humanity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the word as a social human collective rather than an isolated individual or an abstract class.
topics.reason: The local noun is the collective people-word; verbal and participial derivatives from the same root can color sociality and familiarity but do not become the selected local sense.

topics.headline: worshipping human side
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the people as the human side whose worshipful dependence makes the deity relation visible.
topics.reason: The idafa licenses the people as the complement to the deity-title, while the root-pair row supports the local divine-human pairing without making it a separate topic invented from reference evidence.

topics.headline: protected target source arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same human collective from protected relation into later vulnerability and possible sourcehood within the same surah.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah references: the word in 114:3 points ahead to the interior target in 114:5 and the source phrase in 114:6.

topics.headline: visible social side
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears social visibility and familiar human exposure behind the collective before the surah later pairs humans with hidden sources in 114:6.
topics.reason: The sociability, visibility, and forgetfulness claims are useful root-family or disputed-derivation pressures; local grammar still names the definite human collective.

topics.headline: audible nas closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the human collective as the recurring acoustic close that binds the short refuge formula.
topics.reason: The repeated ayah-ending form and sun-letter assimilation support the sound payoff while leaving the grammatical genitive role unchanged.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct phrase joins `إله` directly to `الناس`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The head names a worship relation, while the dependent noun profiles manifest human presence. The construct therefore presents a center of enacted human devotion, not merely a divine label associated with a species.

activation_trace.role: Worship and the worshipped one make the head noun a relational center of devotion.
Visible human presence supplies the manifest collective whose devotion is in view.

changed_reading.before: A generic divine title assigned to people.
changed_reading.after: The worshipped center toward which the visible human collective directs devotion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `الناس` can profile humans through their capacity to notice by sight, sound, feeling, or inward sensing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The worship relation is attached to awareness-bearing subjects. Humanity is not only a population here; it is the class whose perception can recognize, miss, or misread what solicits its allegiance.

activation_trace.role: The worship branch supplies the orientation that human awareness may recognize or misdirect.
Perception by seeing, hearing, or sensing profiles the people as awareness-bearing subjects.

changed_reading.before: People are a demographic object of divine authority.
changed_reading.after: The deity is related to humans precisely at the level of their perceiving and discerning awareness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The `الناس` inventory carries both familiarity that removes estrangement and the side turned toward a person.
baseline_models.mechanism: Those branch images make the construct capable of an affective-spatial reading: worship is encountered on the human-facing side as a relation of nearness that counters estrangement.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one anchors nearness in devotion rather than generic companionship.
Familiar comfort that removes estrangement gives the human relation an affective function.
The person-facing side gives that comfort a near-side spatial orientation.

changed_reading.before: The phrase marks remote authority over humanity.
changed_reading.after: It can also name the worshipped relation on humanity's near side, where familiarity displaces estrangement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Audible saying initiates refuge, and refuge is directed through a lordly relation of repair and completion. Inside that frame, `إله الناس` changes from a static title into the avowed worship relation by which the speaker enters protective formation.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped-one image supplies the allegiance enacted within the refuge utterance.
Bringing speech out in pronunciation makes the surrounding construction a performed utterance.
Seeking shelter and holding fast supplies the protective action performed by the utterance.
Repair, nurture, and completion make refuge an active process of restoring the speaker.

structural_cues: The imperative `قُلْ` and first-person `أَعُوذُ` place the following titles inside one performed refuge utterance.
`الناس` remains the genitive while the governing title changes across 114:1-3.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pronounced saying, refuge, and reparative nurture; I supply the arrow that avowing the deity-title helps enact entry into that refuge. A live alternative is that the command merely reports the titles without making their pronunciation operative.

changed_reading.before: `إله الناس` is a nominal statement about who God is.
changed_reading.after: `إله الناس` is also an avowed allegiance inside a speech-act of entering restorative protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repairing nurture, governing disposition, and worship form a possible progression while `الناس` remains constant: humans are formed, ordered, and finally oriented in allegiance. The focus title is the culmination of relation rather than a synonym mechanically added to the first two.

activation_trace.role: Worship supplies the terminal relation of allegiance in the three-title sequence.
Nurture, repair, and completion supply the formative first relation.
Possession and power of disposition supply the governing middle relation.
The mainstay of an affair makes kingship the structural pivot between nurture and worship.

structural_cues: The same genitive `الناس` follows three different heads in immediate sequence.
The focus ayah is the shortest and final member of the title series.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sequence plus the branch functions of nurture, disposition, mainstay, and worship; I supply the directional movement from formation through governance to allegiance. The titles may instead be an unordered cumulative stack.

changed_reading.before: `إله الناس` repeats the authority already expressed by lord and king.
changed_reading.after: It names the distinct culmination where being nurtured and governed becomes an orientation of worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent kingship inventory activates strength, cohesion, and a mainstay. Read back through the worship relation, `إله الناس` can describe the shared allegiance that holds a visible collective together, not only the private belief of each member.

activation_trace.role: Common worship supplies the relation capable of binding separate persons.
Visible human presence makes the social collective, rather than an abstract species, the focus.
Strength and cohesion supply the social effect attributed to shared orientation.
A mainstay supplies the image of worship as the collective's organizing support.

structural_cues: `ملك الناس` and `إله الناس` are adjacent constructions with the same dependent collective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cohesion and mainstay under the adjacent kingship root; I transfer those as effects of the focus ayah's shared worship relation. The alternative is to keep cohesion wholly inside political sovereignty.

changed_reading.before: The deity stands over an already constituted set of individuals.
changed_reading.after: Shared orientation to the deity can itself be the mainstay that constitutes people as a coherent public.

context_deltas.mechanism: Refuge as adhering within protection joins the focus inventory's familiar comfort, while the hostile voice is hidden and recurrently retreats. The deity-human relation becomes abiding companionship whose continuity counters an invasive voice defined by unstable appearance.

activation_trace.role: Worship keeps the companionship model anchored in the focus title's devotional relation.
Familiar comfort that removes estrangement supplies the affective quality of protection.
Adhering and remaining within a shelter gives protective nearness temporal persistence.
Hidden self-talk supplies the intimate but hostile voice against which companionship operates.
Retreat into concealment makes the hostile presence intermittent rather than abiding.

structural_cues: The refuge frame precedes the divine titles, while the withdrawing whisperer follows them.
The focus relation stands between sought shelter and unstable hidden speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adhesion in shelter, familiar comfort, hidden self-talk, and retreat; I supply the contrast between stable companionship and intermittent intrusion. A live alternative is that refuge remains juridical protection with no affective companionship.

changed_reading.before: `إله الناس` is primarily a public relation of collective worship.
changed_reading.after: It also names an abiding, estrangement-removing nearness that outlasts the whisperer's arrivals and withdrawals.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flying sparks, a low hidden sound, and star-like hiding and return converge on intermittent stimulation. The perceptive-human baseline is therefore revised: human awareness is a pulsed field, and the worship relation supplies a stable reference through sensory flicker.

activation_trace.role: Worship supplies a durable orientation against intermittent solicitations.
Seeing, hearing, and sensing locate the contest inside human perceptual awareness.
Scattered fire-sparks supply brief, attention-catching bursts.
A hidden low sound supplies a stimulus near the threshold of hearing.
Stars that disappear and return supply a recurring visibility cycle.

structural_cues: The threat description immediately follows the completed three-title sequence.
`الخناس` modifies the whispering source, combining low signal with recurrent withdrawal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sparks, hidden sound, recurrent disappearance, and perceptive humanity; I supply their shared temporal pattern and contrast it with stable worship. They may instead remain unrelated lexical images with no common attention model.

changed_reading.before: The deity is related to humans as generally perceptive beings.
changed_reading.after: The deity is the stable orientation of perceivers whose attention is vulnerable to brief, low, repeatedly vanishing signals.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-dominant mapped branch of `ش ر ر` activates exchange and equivalence. activation_trace.role: The worshipped object supplies what covert exchange attempts to replace or reprice.
Exchange between buying and selling supplies the transactional mechanism.
Equivalence and comparison supply the whispered claim that a substitute has matching value.
Hidden self-talk locates the bargaining process inside apparently private thought.
Withdrawal into concealment lets the proposal evade inspection after it is planted.

structural_cues: `شَرِّ` governs the whole whisperer construction, allowing its split inventory to color the threat's mechanism.
The threat appears only after the focus ayah has identified the object of worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies a non-dominant exchange branch, equivalence, hidden self-talk, and retreat; I supply the arrow from exchange to substitution of allegiance. The ordinary harm branch remains a live and much nearer alternative.

changed_reading.before: `إله الناس` identifies the proper object of worship before an unspecified evil.
changed_reading.after: It fixes the non-substitutable object of worship against covert inner bargains that counterfeit equivalence and trade allegiance away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hidden self-talk enters the breast understood as the source from which actions issue, while the repeated human root can narrow toward one's own self. The focus worship relation is thus upstream governance of action-generation, exactly where rival impulses seek to become deeds.

activation_trace.role: Worship supplies the governing allegiance whose practical effects emerge as action.
Hidden self-talk supplies the covert input introduced before action becomes visible.
The origin from which actions issue supplies the causal location of the contest.
The idiom of one's self or intimate companion makes the apparently private self the immediate target.

structural_cues: The prepositional phrase `في صدور الناس` explicitly locates whispering inside the people named by the focus construct.
The same `الناس` is first related to the deity and later named as the interior site of intrusion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden self-talk, an action-origin, and the private self; I supply the arrow that competing inward inputs become outward deeds and that worship governs this upstream point. `صدور` may remain chiefly anatomical without the causal extension.

changed_reading.before: The focus phrase governs the public fact of human worship.
changed_reading.after: It reaches the pre-action source of the self, where allegiance organizes which inner prompt is allowed to issue as conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to say spans both articulated speech and a qawl branch for unmanifested inner saying; the later whisper is hidden self-talk. `إله الناس` can therefore function as the allegiance-marker that distinguishes avowed speech from speech that arrives covertly in the first-person register.

activation_trace.role: The worship relation supplies the criterion by which competing speech channels are oriented.
Pronounced saying supplies the overt and accountable speech channel.
Unmanifested saying within the self shows that qawl can also occupy an inner channel.
Hidden self-talk supplies the covert channel that can masquerade as one's own thought.

structural_cues: An imperative of saying opens the unit, while a finite verb of whispering later defines the threat.
The focus title lies between the overt command and the covert speech description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overt saying, inner saying, and hidden self-talk; I supply the competition between accountable avowal and covertly inserted speech. A live alternative is that these are merely different speech modes without a contest over authorship.

changed_reading.before: `إله الناس` is content named by the speaker.
changed_reading.after: It becomes the allegiance by which a person tests whether inner or outer speech is avowed, answerable, and truly one's own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending coordinates hidden beings with visible humans as source classes. The very people attached to the deity in the focus ayah are therefore not only recipients of protection; they can become relays of concealed prompting to one another, making the worship relation a safeguard within a porous social network.

activation_trace.role: Shared worship supplies the relation that can orient humans despite influence moving through the group.
Visible human presence identifies the focus collective later reused as a possible source class.
Hidden beings supply one concealed origin of the invasive prompting.
Visible humans supply the coordinated second origin and make social transmission possible.

structural_cues: The closing coordination `من الجنة والناس` pairs hidden and visible source classes.
`الناس` moves from dependent of the deity in 114:3 to a coordinated source category in 114:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the hidden-visible pairing and recurrence of the same human noun; I supply the network arrow by which humans relay covert influence to other humans. The alternative is a simple two-species classification with no emphasis on transmission.

changed_reading.before: The people in `إله الناس` are only protected beneficiaries.
changed_reading.after: They are a porous collective whose members may receive or transmit hidden pressure, so shared worship also governs social mediation.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it concerns allegiance within a crowd whose very density can hide agency and circulate influence without a visible author.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses a route owned under `م ل ك` with a horse's lateral veering under `خ ن س`. It remains anchored in `إله` as orientation of worship and in the immediate title-threat sequence. surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Worship in `إله` supplies an orientation, while the neighboring context inventories supply a governed route and a sudden deviation from motion.

activation_trace.role: Devotional orientation supplies the course from which deviation matters.
The person-facing side supplies a directional face for human orientation.
Owning a road or valley supplies the image of a course lying within ordered jurisdiction.
A horse veering during its run supplies lateral deflection without stopping forward motion.

changed_reading.before: `إله الناس` is a destination named independently of movement.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is the orienting course of human allegiance, while whispering works as a concealed lateral deviation that can occur even during apparent forward motion.

strongest_changes: The nominal title became a performed allegiance inside an utterance of restorative refuge.
The three repeated constructs formed a live progression from nurture through governance to worship, while also supporting a distinct social-cohesion reading.
Whispering in the action-source moved the deity-human relation upstream into authorship of thought, speech, and conduct.
The final hidden-visible pairing made humans both protected perceivers and possible relays of covert influence.
The split `ش ر ر` mapping preserved an exploratory counter-reading of temptation as covert exchange rather than reducing every branch to generic evil.
summary.what_was_special: A two-word focus ayah remained multiply active because `الناس` could mark visible collectivity, perception, familiar nearness, private selfhood, and even an optical human image. Repetition kept that noun stable while lordship, kingship, worship, hidden speech, interior action, and hidden-visible sources changed around it; the result is several coexisting public, affective, perceptual, social, and causal readings rather than one harmonized title.
remaining_uncertainties: The nurture-governance-worship progression may be directional, or the three titles may simply accumulate without an ordered mechanism.
The intermittent-attention and route models depend on analogical transfer among branch images rather than direct lexical predication.
The non-dominant exchange mapping is packet-backed but remains much more form-distant than the ordinary harm branch.
The closing coordination clearly juxtaposes hidden and visible classes, but its exact force as a transmission network remains reader-supplied.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Worship as the deepest site of protection.** Evidence: ء ل ه B001, worship and the worshipped one; ر ب ب B001 and م ل ك B003 from 114:1-2, authority and dominion; و س و س B001 from 114:5, what is cast into the heart; ص د ر B001/B004 from 114:5, chest and source from which actions issue. Structural cue: إله comes after رب and ملك, then the packet reveals the attack as internal whisper. Assigned role: إله names the final attachment or worship-center of the people. Abductive move: a whisper in the chest is dangerous because it can redirect devotion, not merely because it annoys. Reading change: “God of people” reads as securing the ultimate inward orientation of the same people already owned and governed.

2. **Invocation-name completed.** Evidence: ء ل ه B002 in 114:0, Allah as fixed name in invocation formulas; ء ل ه B001 here, worship and the worshipped one; ق و ل B001 from 114:1, uttered speech. Structural cue: the basmalah names Allah before “قل أعوذ,” and 114:3 rearticulates the divine relation as إله الناس. Assigned role: the ayah converts the proper-name invocation into a relational claim over people. Abductive move: the opening formula and the refuge formula are one speech-chain; the named one in the basmalah is the one invoked as worshipped protector here. Reading change: 114:3 reads as the completion of the basmalah’s invocation logic, not only the third item in a list.

3. **People as worshippers under oscillation.** Evidence: ن و س B001, swaying or dangling oscillation; ق و ل B013 from 114:1, belief or held doctrine; و س و س B001, inward whisper. Structural cue: the third repeated الناس is followed by the disclosure of a whisperer that works in the same الناس. Assigned role: الناس are not just subjects but inwardly persuadable worshippers. Abductive move: oscillation in the human field includes doctrinal or devotional wavering because the threat is inner saying. Reading change: “people” becomes a site of competing inward allegiance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 114:5 retrospectively made “إله الناس” the deepest layer of the refuge sequence. Since the whisper works inside the chest, ء ل ه B001 is not simply a title of worship but the contested center of inward allegiance. 114:0 also returned here: ء ل ه B002 in “ٱللَّه” made this ayah feel like the expansion of the opening invocation, while 114:1’s “قل” supplied the uttered form of that invocation. The surprise is that the three titles do not merely accumulate grandeur; they move inward from care and rule to devotion, exactly where the whisper will operate.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Devotional orientation completes the protective sequence.** ء ل ه `B001` gives `إِلَٰهِ` worship, devotion, and the one treated as the object of worship. Structurally, it completes the progression `رَبِّ` (care), `مَلِكِ` (rule), `إِلَٰهِ` (devotion) immediately before the evil is specified. The packet supplies that order; I infer nurture and governance -> a settled orientation of allegiance that covert whispering seeks to disturb. The phrase therefore reads as the culminating protective relation, not merely a third synonymous title.

2. **The fixed divine name becomes a human relation.** The same ء ل ه root appeared in 114:0 as `ٱللَّهِ`, activating `B002` (fixed name in invocation formulas), and now appears as `إِلَٰهِ`, directly activating `B001` (the worshipped one). Between them stands `قُلْ أَعُوذُ`, so the root recurrence links named invocation to relational devotion. The packet supplies name, appeal, and title; I infer the recurrence -> identification of the one invoked by name with the one to whom the wavering `ٱلنَّاسِ` orient themselves. `إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ` thus closes an invocation arc opened by the basmalah.

3. **The title governs the conversion of whispers into commitments.** ء ل ه `B001` supplies devotion, while contextual ق و ل `B012/B013` distinguishes an unspoken inner saying from a belief or held doctrine, and و س و س `B001` supplies the passing inner whisper. The packet does not state that every whisper becomes belief; I infer repeated hidden saying -> possible settled commitment, with `إِلَٰهِ` serving as the criterion that blocks that conversion into rival allegiance. The fixed ayah consequently reads as protection of worship and conviction at their formative stage, not only as a statement about divine status.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 114:4-5 made the devotional title intervene earlier than overt worship: the threat begins as hidden speech before it can settle into commitment. 114:6 added a social correction, since human sources can mediate that pressure; rival orientation need not arrive only from a concealed nonhuman agent.

findings.text: Rablikten ve hükümdarlıktan sonra gelen ilahlık, korunmayı insanın en içteki kulluk ve bağlılık yönelimine kadar taşır; fısıltı tam da bu yönü saptırabilir.
Açılışta özel adıyla çağrılan Allah, burada insanların kulluk ettiği ilah olarak ilişki içinde tanımlanır ve başlangıçtaki yakarış tamamlanır.
İlah unvanı, geçici bir iç fısıltının yerleşik inanç veya rakip bağlılığa dönüşmesini daha başlangıç aşamasında engelleyen ölçüyü de gösterir.
İnsanların son ayette fısıltı kaynağı olarak da görünmesi, kulluk yönelimini etkileyen baskının yalnız görünmeyen değil, insan kaynaklı da olabileceğini gösterir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin güvenilir çekirdeği, bir şeyin insana veya onu kullanan kişiye dönük ve yakın olan yanıdır. Bu yanın solda mı sağda mı olduğu konusunda aktarımlar uyuşmaz; hayvan ve yay örnekleri yönü işlevsel ilişkiyle belirler. Bu nedenle sabit bir sağ-sol tanımı dalın özüne konamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın insana dönük yan çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır. Hayvan ve yay uygulamaları bu çekirdeğin örneklenmesidir; yalnız bu kullanımlardan yeni bir genel yön anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin insana, kullanıcıya veya onun bulunduğu yöne bakan yanıdır. Hayvan ve yay üzerinde işlevsel ilişkiyle belirlenir; bu yanın sabit olarak sol ya da sağ sayılması konusunda aktarım uyuşmazlığı vardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin insana en yakın olan veya insana doğru bakan yanını belirtir.
Hayvanda binicinin bulunduğu, binme ve sağma işlemlerinde insana yakın olan yanı anlatır.
Yayda okçuya doğru bakan ve kullanıcının karşısında bulunan yanı anlatır.
İnsana yakın yan bazı aktarımda sol, başka bir aktarımda sağ diye belirlenir; yönün özü bu değişken tanımlardan bağımsızdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, nesnenin insana veya kullanıcıya dönük yanıdır; hayvanda biniciye, yayda okçuya göre belirlenir. İnsan bedenindeki tekil uygulamada öteki bacağa bakan yan kastedilir. Bu yanın solda mı sağda mı bulunduğuna ilişkin anlatımlar ayrıştığı için genel tanım sabit bir yön seçmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak çekirdeği, gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Parmak ucu anlamı tek aktarım içinde eklenir ve gözdeki görüntünün kurucu parçası değildir; bağımlı bir kaynak varyantı olarak tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dalın çekirdeği gözün kara bölümündeki küçük görüntüdür. Parmak ucu aktarımı bağımlı bir varyanttır; gözle ilgili belirli biçimlerden genel görüntü veya genel insan anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Ayrı bir kaynak kullanımında aynı ad parmak ucuna da verilir, ancak bu kullanım göz görüntüsü çekirdeğini değiştirmez.

facets.statement: Göz bebeğinin kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntüyü veya yansımayı adlandırır.
Ayrı bir aktarımda parmak ucu veya eldeki parmak ucunu anlatan kullanım da aynı adla verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak aktarım, göz bebeğinin kara bölümünde görülen küçük görüntüyü bir insan biçimi olarak tanımlar. Buna ek olarak parmak ucu anlamı da bildirilir, fakat bu ek kullanım gözdeki yansıma çekirdeğinden ayrı tutulur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki ayrı kalıplaşmış ilişkiyi açıkça ayırır: kişiye kendi durumunu soran sözde kişinin kendisi, bir başkasına bağlanan sözde ise seçilmiş yakın ve sırdaş kastedilir. Yakın arkadaş ve oturup konuşulan kişi için verilen paralel adlar ikinci alanı destekler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kişinin kendisini soran kuruluş, seçilmiş yakını belirten kuruluş ve yakın arkadaş adları ayrı tutulur. Bunların hiçbiri çıplak biçime genel kişi veya akrabalık anlamı olarak taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir soru kuruluşunda muhatabın kendisini ve durumunu, başka bir kişiyle kurulan adlandırmada ise onun seçilmiş yakınını, sırdaşını veya sürekli görüştüğü arkadaşını belirtir. İki kullanım aynı kuruluş ailesinde bulunsa da katılımcı ilişkileri ayrıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye kendi durumunu soran belirli kuruluşta muhatabın kendisini gösterir.
Bir kişiye bağlanarak söylendiğinde onun seçilmiş yakınını, özel arkadaşını veya sırdaşını belirtir.
Aynı anlam çevresindeki paralel adlar yakın dostu, içten arkadaşı ve oturup konuşulan kişiyi gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, doğrudan hitapta kişinin kendi durumunu soran kullanım ile birinin seçkin yakını ve sırdaşını gösteren kullanımı birlikte verir. Yakın dost ve sürekli görüşülen arkadaş anlamındaki paralel adlar ikinci ilişki alanını genişletir.
